notablePrerequisites: Faeburrow Elder does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Derevi, adding {1}.
Choose to have Derevi return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Derevi by paying {1}{G}{W}{U}, putting Derevi onto the battlefield from the command zone.
Derevi enters the battlefield, untapping Faeburrow Elder.
Repeat.
